display.purpose: Hero headline only. Tight line-height, negative tracking.

headline.purpose: All section h2. Fluid clamp, negative tracking.

body.purpose: All paragraph text. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: Overlines, trust labels, button text, nav links. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: header-lift
shadows.purpose: Applied to sticky header after 8px scroll only. The only permitted shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: All state transitions: button hover, header shadow, reveal animations.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.notes: Header collapses to mobile layout: pictogram logo, hamburger, no nav links.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Section padding reduces to 88px. Projects grid 2-col.

breakpoints.name: small

components.name: Hero Button
components.description: Larger CTA button used in the hero section.

components.css: .ds-header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100; height: 100px; background: transparent; transition: height 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), background 0.35s, box-shadow 0.35s; } .ds-header.scrolled { height: 80px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-header-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 48px; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 48px; } .ds-logo-product { font-family: 'Goodly', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 34px); color: #ffffff; } .ds-header.scrolled .ds-logo-product { color: #2e2e2e; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 36px; flex: 1; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav a { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; } .ds-header.scrolled .ds-nav a { color: #2e2e2e; }

components.name: Trust Stat
components.description: One stat in the trust bar. Light fog background. Orange number (deep variant), ash label.
components.css: .ds-trust-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 40px; text-align: center; } .ds-trust-num { font-family: 'Goodly', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 52px); line-height: 1; color: #c45a0a; } .ds-trust-label { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #696969; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Project grid item. Full-bleed image, caption overlay at bottom. Dark section context.
components.css: .ds-project-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-project-card img { width: 100%; height: 420px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 2px; display: block; } .ds-project-card figcaption { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 20px 24px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 0%, transparent 100%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-project-name { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); } .ds-project-spec { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }

Can it navigate around trees and natural obstacles?

components.css: .ds-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(46,46,46,0.1); } .ds-faq-question { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 28px 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-family: 'Goodly', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; color: #2e2e2e; gap: 24px; user-select: none; } .ds-faq-question::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq-question::after { content: '+'; font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 300; color: #ff751f; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-faq-item[open] .ds-faq-question::after { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-answer { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.8; color: #2e2e2e; padding-bottom: 32px; max-width: 720px; }

narrative.overview:
This system feels like a site plan for mountain infrastructure: raw photography of real terrain, structural typography, signal orange used the way safety markers are used on a job site. Nothing decorative. Every element either carries load or stays invisible.

The palette is minimal by necessity, not restraint. CDC Ember (#ff751f) is the only signal color. Everything else is surface. Sections alternate dark and light to create rhythm without competing visual weight. No two dark sections adjacent.

Real photography from real installations is non-negotiable. The Langkawi installation is the hero credential; every other project card extends that proof.
keyCharacteristics: Signal orange on dark: full #ff751f brightness
Signal orange as text on light: always #c45a0a (ember-deep)
Goodly display font for all headings — custom weight, not a web default
Section spacing varies deliberately: 128px standard, 160px editorial, 88px utility
Zero decoration: no gradients, no glassmorphism, no icon arrays

rules.name: The Two-Orange Rule
rules.body: CDC Ember (#ff751f) is for dark backgrounds. CDC Ember Deep (#c45a0a) is for light and white backgrounds. Never use the full ember on white or fog as text.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only accent color. It appears on less than 15% of any given screen. Its scarcity is the point.

rules.name: The Goodly-Only Headings Rule
rules.body: Every h1, h2, h3 uses Goodly. Lato is prohibited in headings.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Hero display text uses line-height 0.95 and negative tracking. Compressed, like type on engineering drawings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The header shadow is the only permitted shadow, and only as a scroll-state signal.

dos: Use CDC Ember (#ff751f) exclusively on dark backgrounds
Use CDC Ember Deep (#c45a0a) whenever orange appears as text on white or fog backgrounds
Keep all button text Site Dark (#2e2e2e) on Ember backgrounds — 6.7:1 contrast
Alternate section backgrounds: dark → light → white. Never two dark sections adjacent
Use real installation photography from CDC's actual projects
Keep Goodly for every heading — display, headline, title
Use Lato 700 uppercase for all labels, overlines, button text, navigation
Vary section padding: 128px standard, 160px editorial, 88px utility
Use negative letter-spacing on display and headline text
donts: Don't use CDC Ember (#ff751f) as text color on white or fog
Don't use white text on Ember buttons — 2.7:1 contrast fails WCAG AA
Don't add side-stripe border accents (border-left colored stripe)
Don't add glassmorphism, blurs, or translucent layers
Don't use numbered step treatments (01/02/03 pattern)
Don't use pill badge labels — SaaS cliché
Don't add hero eyebrow chips (tracked-caps label above H1)
Don't use em-dashes in body copy — AI writing tell
Don't animate layout properties (padding, margin, height, width)
Don't add shadows to cards, sections, or images
Don't place identical card grids (icon + heading + text repeated)
Don't use Lato in headings or Goodly in body copy
Don't use Inter, DM Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans, Fraunces, or reflex-reject fonts
Don't add third-party JavaScript, frameworks, or build tools
